subject: Quick follow-up + security intake for Medicorps
messages:

Date: 2027-05-04T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + security intake for Medicorps

Alex — thanks for taking time today. Short recap and next steps: 

- Medicorps is evaluating for a patient-facing triage assistant (HIPAA scope flagged).
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 status, data residency, and PHI handling during inference.

Next steps we agreed on:
1) Security intake: Mina (cc'd) will start a SIG-lite/CAIQ triage and surface any blocking asks.
2) Procurement: Lara will share standard PO / timeline constraints.
3) Technical: we can run a demo with a sanitized dataset next week if helpful.

Mina, can you initiate the questionnaire and flag any immediate redlines (e.g., no off-cloud logging, dedicated tenancy asks)?

Thanks — Ben

-- 
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@medicorps.com>

Date: 2027-05-04T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + security intake for Medicorps

Ben — appreciate the recap. A couple of clarifying items from InfoSec/Procurement: 

- SOC 2: Are you currently SOC 2 Type II certified? If yes, can you share the most recent report or at least the scope and date?
- HIPAA: Do you sign BAA for hosted deployments and do you offer VPC/private deployment options?
- Questionnaire: We prefer a SIG Lite to start. Who will own the prefill and evidence collection?

If Mina can own the SIG initiation, please include a short evidence matrix and an expected timeline (we typically ask for SOC artifacts + encryption key management info within 7-10 business days).

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Ramirez
Senior InfoSec Manager, Medicorps Health
alex.ramirez@medicorps.com | +1 617-555-0147
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: alex.ramirez@medicorps.com, lara.hill@medicorps.com
Date: 2027-05-04T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + security intake for Medicorps

Ben — noted, I'll take point on the SIG initiation. Quick internal checklist/questions before I send them the prefill: 

1) Which deployment options will we propose? (hosted with dedicated tenancy / Dedicated / Private VPC). If we can confirm dedicated tenancy for PHI, that'll remove a lot of procurement friction.
2) SOC 2 artifacts: Marcus (sec team) already shared a SOC2 summary stub and date (report issued 2026-11). Do we want to share the summary doc first and offer an NDA to release the full report?
3) KMS/HSM details: need clear language on whether customers can bring keys (BYOK) for Private and Dedicated customers.

I drafted a short evidence matrix and a SIG-lite prefill template (attached). My plan: send a single email to Alex + Lara that includes: 
- SIG-lite prefill (filled where possible)
- Evidence matrix (what we can provide vs. what we'll need from Medicorps)
- Expected timeline and contact for follow-ups

Ben — any priority items I should call out to reduce turnaround?
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0126
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@medicorps.com>, Lara Hill <lara.hill@medicorps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG-lite initiation + evidence asks (Medicorps)

Alex / Lara — following up with the SIG-lite initiation and a short evidence matrix attached. Summary below and quick asks to keep the intake moving: 

Summary / what we can provide now:
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in scope for our hosted inference control plane (report issued 2026-11). Attached is a one-page SOC2-summary-stub and our SIG-lite prefill.
- Deployments: We offer Hosted (with optional dedicated tenancy), Dedicated reserved GPU pools, and Private VPC on-prem options. For PHI/HIPAA workloads we recommend Private VPC or Dedicated with isolated tenancy — I noted that recommendation in the prefill.
- Encryption/KMS: For Private deployments customers can use BYOK via supported KMS integrations. For Hosted we provide customer key options for enterprise plans; I'll flag exact KMS partners in the evidence matrix.

Immediate asks from Medicorps (what we need from you):
1) Confirm desired deployment model (Private VPC vs. Dedicated tenancy).
2) If requesting SOC2 report access, please sign the attached mutual NDA (or let me know an alternate process) and we'll route the full report.
3) Provide a single technical contact and an SSO metadata endpoint if you want SAML-enabled test accounts for the demo environment.

Attachments (stubs):
- SIG-Initiation-Template.pdf (prefill with redwood answers)
- evidence-matrix-sample.xlsx (column: artifact, owner, timeline)
- SOC2-summary-stub.pdf
I expect an initial turnaround of ~7 business days for the SIG-lite prefill + evidence we can supply; anything requiring external audit access (full SOC2) may take longer due to procurement.
Please let me know if you want this as a shared Drive folder or a HubSpot intake ticket — happy to match your process.
Thanks,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
